scope: length sweep result: NO tail length in {40,60,80} is accepted - padding cannot terminate the actors block

experiment.method: all three sent in one session (cycle 2 s), state sampled at t=20/30/40/50/60

conclusion: no zero-padded tail length between 40 and 80 is accepted
combined with the earlier runs (27, 120, 400 zero bits) the actors block never terminates on padding - it consumes to the end of the stream and sets the global error
so a snapshot that carries a real playerState (has-ps=1) cannot be completed by padding: the actors payload needs its own valid encoding
this is the same class of blocker as the entity loop: a block with no count-based exit whose payload format is still unknown

status.what_works: handshake, gamestate, snapshots (state 10) when the ps is skipped; match end; lobby return; full observability
status.what_blocks_the_world: the actors payload format (required as soon as a playerState is present)

next_options: reverse-engineer the actors block payload (0x471010 and its callees) - a fresh RE sub-project with the same tooling constraints
or accept the current deliverable (RELEASE.md) and track the visible world as a separate phase
